product_information.title: Indication
product_information.value: Renagel is indicated for the control of hyperphosphataemia in adult patients receiving haemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis. Renagel should be used within the context of a multiple therapeutic approach, which could include calcium supplements, 1,25 – dihydroxy Vitamin D<sub>3</sub> or one of its analogues to control the development of renal bone disease.
